item.title: Multivariate Time Series Classification
item.description:
• Built a predictive XGBoost model to forecast intracerebral hemorrhage using time-series data and PubMed radiology reports.
  • Achieved 74.11% accuracy and 75.51% precision, aiding hospital decisions by identifying high-risk patients.

item.title: Image Style Transfer with VGG Network
item.description:
• Implemented image style transfer methodology using convolutional neural networks.
  • Used a pretrained VGG 19 network to extract content and style representations, generating a new target image.

item.title: Sequence to Sequence Stock Time Series Prediction Model
item.description:
• Developed an LSTM-based seq2seq model for stock prediction using Alpha Vantage API and PyTorch.
  • Added CLI features for stock prediction, data plotting, and model saving, delivering accurate predictions with documentation.
